newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks in London up on bargain hunting.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks in London up on bargain hunting.

text.p: Japanese stocks in London rose slightly in thin trade on Monday as bargain hunters snapped up stocks that suffered in last week's fall, dealers said.
By 1500 GMT, the Nikkei 50 index was 7.96 points higher at 1,445.32, following a quiet session in Tokyo, which saw the Nikkei 225 close up 80.65 points at 20,422.04.

"There's been very little action, but what we have seen is buying in the laggard sectors," said one dealer. "During the fall in the market in the last week, some sectors like banking, construction, marine and insurance fell perhaps too far and we've seen bargain hunting in those issues today."
